intent: One plan card under a monthly/annual switch. The thumb glides, each price digit spins like a slot reel with motion blur, a save badge springs in, and an optional seats stepper tweens the total.

stack.animation: motion/react (layoutId, motion values, useVelocity, springs, AnimatePresence)

layout.root: @container column, max-width 420px, centred; switch 20px above the card
layout.card: #0b0b0c, radius 22px, padding 24px (28px @sm); header, price, note, seats panel, CTA, hairline, features, footnote
layout.switch: inline-grid 2 columns, 4px padding, each option min 104px x 36px
layout.seatsPanel: radius 14px, stepper row + total row split by a hairline

color.card: #0b0b0c with inset white/8% hairline and white/6% top highlight
color.accent: #7dd3a8 (checks, badge ring and fill at 12%), badge text #9be7c0

motion.reels: strip 0-9 x5, 1.1em cells; all reels spin up when price rises, down when it falls; spring stiffness 120, damping 19; 55ms stagger; silent jump back to the middle copy on settle
motion.motionBlur: blur(min(2.4, |velocity in digits/s| / 9) px) on each reel
motion.digitCount: columns keyed from the right; new ones grow from width 0 over 300ms
motion.badge: spring stiffness 520, damping 20, from scale 0.6 and y 4px, origin right; exit 140ms ease-in
motion.note: cross-fade: in y 8px + blur 3px over 300ms, out y -8px over 180ms
motion.seats: count rolls 10px in the direction of change over 220ms; total tweens 450ms ease-out
motion.checks: pathLength draw 450ms, 70ms stagger, once in view
motion.cta: hover arrow +2px; press 0.98; loading spinner; success check draws 340ms; resets after 2.6s
motion.reducedMotion: reels jump, no blur, fades only (150ms), checks pre-drawn

responsive.all: fluid up to 420px; price size uses cqi so it scales with the card; padding steps up at @sm
responsive.touch: stepper buttons and switch options keep 44px-equivalent targets

accessibility: billing switch is a radiogroup with roving tabindex and arrow keys
visual price aria-hidden; sr-only sentence with price, unit and note
polite live region summarising billing, seats and total
stepper is a labelled group; buttons labelled 'Add a seat' / 'Remove a seat' and disabled at limits
CTA aria-busy while loading plus a status message

content.plan: Team: For product teams who write things down and can find them again.
features: Unlimited docs, with full version history
Guests at no extra cost, with per-page access
Support from people who use it daily
content.cta: Start 14-day trial / Setting up your trial… / Check your inbox
content.footnote: Prices in USD. Tax added at checkout.

avoid: a three-plan section or marketing headline
digits that cross-fade instead of rolling
layout shift when the total or unit changes
